hero.badge: NOW CASTING — Open to Machine Learning / AI Engineering roles · Chicago, IL
hero.sub: I'm Sudheer Kumar Gandiboyana — a DePaul University MSBA graduate in Chicago, open to full-time Machine Learning, AI Engineering, Data Science, and Analytics Engineering roles. I build and deploy real systems: NLP pipelines that classify at scale, a published PyPI package, and full-stack AI products running on production infrastructure.

about.intro: I combine rigorous analysis with modern machine learning engineering to turn messy, high-stakes data into decisions, models, and shipped AI products.
paragraphs: I'm a Master of Science in Business Analytics graduate from DePaul University's Kellstadt Graduate School of Business (GPA 3.925), with hands-on experience from a Data Analytics internship at Unified Mentor. I completed the Stanford Machine Learning Specialization and the DeepLearning.AI Deep Learning Specialization, then applied those concepts in shipped projects: classical ML in a 145-class NLP classifier and agent orchestration in a self-hosted multi-agent platform with 293 passing tests.

Today I work across the full stack end-to-end: SQL and Python for the data layer, scikit-learn/XGBoost/TensorFlow and LLM agents for the intelligence layer, Power BI/Tableau for the story, and Node.js, FastAPI, Docker, and Nginx when the answer is "build and deploy the product." Outside coursework, I ship independent projects to real infrastructure — a published PyPI package with a full test suite, a production chat app serving real users, and a self-hosted AI agent platform — because the fastest way to prove I can do the job, and the fastest way to actually learn it, is to already be doing it.

I'm seeking a full-time Machine Learning Engineering, AI Engineering, Data Science, or Analytics Engineering role where I can contribute across the full product lifecycle. I learn quickly, ship what I learn, and bring a track record of turning unfamiliar tools into working, deployed systems.

projects.name: HAI Messenger
projects.description: A free, self-hosted, end-to-end encrypted chat app — real-time messaging, voice notes, photo/document sharing, live location, in-chat mini-games, and an anonymous 24-hour "Nearby" chat mode, plus a built-in local-LLM AI assistant. Deployed on a self-managed Docker + Cloudflare Tunnel stack with a GitHub Actions self-hosted runner for zero-touch CI/CD, running live for real users on its own domain.

projects.name: bizpack
projects.description: Published open-source Python library that cleans messy corporate spreadsheets for pandas — accounting negatives, multi-currency columns, mixed date formats, summary-footer inflation, and leading-zero IDs. 43 unit tests, 100% pass rate. Ships with a Streamlit demo UI and full PyPI packaging, versioning, and docs.

projects.name: Hagent
projects.description: Self-hosted multi-agent orchestration platform — CLI + web dashboard with pluggable AI runtimes (Claude, OpenAI, local Ollama), cron-triggered autopilots that rebalance workload and fail over between runtimes automatically, and a full Kanban issue tracker for managing agent-driven work. ~11,500 lines of Python, 293 passing tests, built solo in about a month.

projects.name: MorningStar NLP
projects.description: Grew out of my DePaul capstone (MGT 599): an NLP pipeline using TF-IDF and LinearSVC to classify corporate text descriptions into 145 hierarchical GICS industries, reaching macro F1 ≈ 0.83 with custom knowledge-based imputation and class-imbalance tuning.

projects.name: Auto Data Analyst
projects.description: End-to-end ML web app that takes any raw dataset and automates the entire pipeline — cleaning, EDA, and model training across Linear/Ridge/Lasso Regression, Random Forest, Gradient Boosting, XGBoost, and LightGBM — with a Streamlit UI and Docker deployment so a non-technical user gets a trained, evaluated model with zero code.

projects.name: H-AI Assistant
projects.description: A local, memory-aware AI assistant built with Ollama and Llama 3 — multi-user support, persistent conversation history, and monthly keyword summaries for consistent, personal terminal-based chats.
